summary: Runway Growth Finance Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its credit agreement, reducing the credit facility commitment from $550 million to $425 million, effective June 30, 2026. The amendment also permits non-pro rata prepayment/termination of a lender's commitments, adjusts financial covenants, updates key person triggers, and modifies loan eligibility and borrowing base concentration limits. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is involved; this is a routine debt facility amendment that does not constitute a special situation. There is no event to watch or risk-arb angle.
